testo: Welcome to this lesson on work today. We will look at five topics. First, today's job market. Second, job stability. Third, flexibility at work. Fourth, digital communication. And fifth, employability skills. After each topic you will see a concept map and a short quiz. You need at least eighty percent to continue. Let's begin.

Let's review the whole lesson. The job market is changing, and skills are more important than experience. Jobs are less stable, and the gig economy gives flexibility, but low pay. Flexible working, like hybrid work and flexitime, is now the norm. Digital communication is instant, and Zoom became a global giant. And employability skills help you to find a job and to work well. Now it is time for the final test.
It is time for the final test.
And now, your homework.
Here are the key words of the lesson, in English and in Italian.
job market. employee. employer. wage. unemployment. job vacancy. skill. gig economy. freelancer. temporary. income. benefits.
remote working. work-life balance. job sharing. hybrid work. flexitime. part-time. video conferencing. productivity. soft skills. deadline. teamwork. problem-solving.
Here is the map of this topic.
In the job market, businesses that need employees meet people who are looking for work.
A tight market has many job offers, a slack market has more people looking for work.
Technology creates new professions, especially in I T.
Many employers prefer skills to experience.
Today there are many job vacancies, but the employment rate is still low.
Now the map of job stability.
In the past, people had long-term stable jobs with the same employer.
Today there is more flexibility and less stability, with many short-term jobs.
In the gig economy, people work for a specific length of time, like freelancers.
Gig work gives flexibility, independence and an extra income.
But the pay is modest, there are no benefits, and there is a lot of stress.
This is the map of flexibility at work.
With digital devices, we can work anywhere and at any time.
The Covid-19 pandemic made remote working the norm.
There are many types of flexibility: job sharing, hybrid work, a condensed work week and part-time work.
With flexitime, workers choose when their working day starts and ends.
Gen Z values flexibility, and almost half of them prefer a hybrid model.
Here is the map of digital communication.
Digital communication takes place among the staff and with customers.
Its main forms are emails, instant messaging, live chat and video conferencing.
Information arrives instantly, so companies save time and money.
Zoom grew very fast during the pandemic, and its name is now also a verb.
Now the map of employability skills.
Businesses look for qualifications, but also for soft skills, which we use in real situations.
How you work: initiative, organisation, deadlines and learning.
How you work with others: communication, teamwork, negotiation and valuing diversity.
How you think: problem-solving, numeracy and I T skills.
And now the map of the whole lesson.
Today's job market needs new skills and new professions.
Jobs are less stable, and the gig economy is growing.
Flexible working is now the norm, especially hybrid work.
Digital communication is fast and essential for business.
Employability skills make a person attractive for employers.
